Pipeline (all paths under apps/docs):
- Inputs: public entry points of packages core, runtime, query, next, react, kit, listed in PACKAGES in scripts/entry-points.mjs. resolveEntryPoints() reads each packages/<pkg>/package.json exports (skips ./internal and .md), maps dist/*.d.ts back to src/*.ts. Shared by generate-api and test/api-coverage.test.ts.
- Tool: TypeDoc 0.28.19 + typedoc-plugin-markdown 4.13.0 in scripts/generate-api.mjs, one run per entry point, treatWarningsAsErrors, excludeInternal. Post-processing: namespace exports (export * as X) split to their own pages; rewriteAnchors() rewrites symbol anchors and index.md links to site routes. It imports headings() from scripts/check-links.mjs, which uses github-slugger to reproduce Fumadocs heading ids (the comment says TypeDoc numbers duplicate anchors differently from Fumadocs).
- Output: plain markdown with title/description frontmatter at content/docs/api/<pkg>/<entry>.md (+ <entry>/<ns>.md), plus a hand-templated api/index.mdx listing every entry point. The tree is gitignored (/content/docs/api/) and regenerated by predev, prebuild and pretest hooks in package.json. Nothing is committed, so no hand edits (AGENTS.md rule).
- Consumers: (1) fumadocs-mdx (source.config.ts defineDocs dir content/docs) -> lib/source.ts loader baseUrl /docs -> app/docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx and app/docs/layout.tsx (pageTree sidebar). The sidebar is content/docs/meta.json, whose last page is "api", so the api folder is auto-listed with no per-package nav entry; there is no meta.json inside api/. (2) test/api-coverage.test.ts: per entry point, page file exists with a "### name" heading for every TS export (via the TypeScript checker), and every export has a non-empty TSDoc summary; plus a runEffect assertion on api/next/index.md. (3) test/links.test.ts imports rewriteAnchors; check-links.mjs (run after next build) walks content/docs including api/ and validates links/anchors. (4) Guides link into it only twice: index.mdx:33 -> /docs/api, getting-started-effect.mdx:17 -> /docs/api/core. Search is separate (app/api/search/route.ts, fumadocs createFromSource).

What breaks when fumadocs goes away:
- Not coupled: the generate step itself (TypeDoc to markdown) and api-coverage.test.ts (reads files + TS checker only). These survive unchanged.
- Coupled: (a) anything that renders content/docs/api (pages, pageTree sidebar, TOC, search index) must be rebuilt in ui/start. The api tree is markdown, so it needs the same MDX/markdown pipeline as the guides (D2). api/index.mdx and meta.json "api" need a replacement nav source. (b) anchor ids: check-links.mjs and rewriteAnchors assume github-slugger ids matching Fumadocs; the new renderer must emit identical ids or both change together (links.test.ts pins rewriteAnchors output). (c) typecheck script runs fumadocs-mdx; predev/prebuild/pretest hooks and next dev/build/start scripts get replaced. (d) PACKAGES lists kit, next, react, which are being deleted: those 6+ entries (kit, kit/next, kit/react, next, next/devtools, react) and their pages/tests disappear, so the list must be edited in this rebuild regardless. next.config transpilePackages goes too.
- Open gaps today: PACKAGES has neither ui nor start. ui exports ".", ./jsx-runtime, ./jsx-dev-runtime, ./internal (packages/ui/package.json); start exports ".", ./client. fn-34 text says subpaths jsx-runtime and query, but ui has no query subpath (stale), and jsx-dev-runtime would also become a page unless filtered. Whether ui and start exports all have TSDoc summaries is unmeasured; the coverage test will fail on any that do not.

Recommendation on fn-34: fold into fn-57 (absorb; do not do it as a separate spec before the rebuild). Reason: fn-34 is a few lines in entry-points.mjs plus a test extension and a nav entry that meta.json already gives for free; but the same file's PACKAGES must be cut to the surviving packages and extended with ui and start during the rebuild, so doing it separately means editing the list twice and generating ui pages for a Fumadocs renderer that is being deleted. The generator and coverage test are renderer-agnostic, so fn-57 should keep them and only swap the renderer plus slug source. Acceptance for the fold: PACKAGES = core, runtime, query, ui, start (plus any other survivors decided elsewhere); filter jsx-dev-runtime; fix any missing TSDoc; mark fn-34 superseded/closed when fn-57 is captured. Exception: if the rebuild is sequenced far out (D6), landing fn-34 first is cheap and harmless, since the list edit is trivial.
question: How does generate-api produce the api/ tree and how do pages and the sidebar consume it; does open spec fn-34 (ui API reference in the docs site) fold into this rebuild or stay separate?
title: How is the generated API reference consumed?
